desc: Built for the professional user, the EFLX CE delivers the trusted performance of EOTECH optics in a fully enclosed design that protects the LED from debris, moisture, and impact. The EFLX CE base adapts to either the Leupold Delta Point Pro or Shield RMS-c footprint. Top-mounted controls manage power, reticle brightness, and programmable sleep settings, while shake-awake technology instantly reactivates the sight with the slightest movement. The multi-reticle system lets users choose between a precise 3 MOA dot, a 42 MOA circle, or a combined circle-and-dot conguration. A side-load CR2032 battery delivers up to 25,000 hours of runtime, and large windage and elevation adjusters allow for quick, tool-assisted zeroing. For added condence, an integrated rear backup iron sight is machined directly into the housing.
